title: Keto Algerian Pull Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic tagine recipe, adapted to a keto diet. Enjoy the rich flavors of North African cuisine with this delicious pull tagine dish.
instructions: 1. Heat the cozy (olive oil) in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add the algerian (ras el hanout) and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
3. Add the pull (lamb or beef) and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the nutty (almonds) and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
5. Add the cheese (feta) and stir to combine.
6. Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
7. Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
8. Serve hot, garnished with additional nutty (almonds) if desired.
